cases.translation: The man answered, 'He is a prophet.'
cases.explain: Пророк is a predicate noun describing the subject он, so it stays in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Нет, это не из-за его греха, или ___ его родителей
cases.translation: No, it is not because of his sin, or that of his parents.
cases.explain: The preposition из-за governs the genitive case for both items in the list.
The verb воздать (to render/give) takes an indirect object in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Иисус, проходя мимо, увидел ___ слепого от рождения.
cases.translation: As Jesus passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
cases.explain: The transitive verb увидеть takes a direct object; for animate masculine nouns the accusative form matches the genitive.

cases.sentence: Иисус... смешал слюну с ___ и помазал ею глаза слепому.
cases.translation: Jesus mixed saliva with dirt and anointed the blind man's eyes with it.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning 'with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Пока я в ___, я свет миру.
cases.translation: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Однажды Иисус, проходя мимо, увидел человека слепого от рождения.
reading.question: What was notable about the man Jesus saw?
reading.explain: The text says Jesus saw a man 'слепого от рождения' (blind from birth).

reading.ru: Ученики его спросили, «Рабби, почему этот человек родился слепым? Кто согрешил, он сам или его родители?»
reading.question: What did the disciples ask about the blind man?
options: Whether he or his parents had sinned to cause his blindness
Whether he could be healed on the Sabbath
reading.correct: Whether he or his parents had sinned to cause his blindness
reading.explain: The disciples asked who sinned, the man himself or his parents, that he was born blind.

reading.ru: «Это произошло для того, чтобы на нем были явлены Божьи дела.
reading.question: According to Jesus, why was the man born blind?
options: So that God's works might be displayed in him
It was simply an accident of nature
reading.correct: So that God's works might be displayed in him
reading.explain: Jesus said it happened so that God's works would be revealed in him.

reading.ru: Сказав это, Иисус плюнул на землю, смешал слюну с землей и помазал ею глаза слепому.
reading.question: What did Jesus do to heal the blind man's eyes?
options: He made mud from spit and dirt and anointed the man's eyes
He touched the eyes with a cloth
He poured oil on the man's head
reading.correct: He made mud from spit and dirt and anointed the man's eyes
reading.explain: Jesus spat on the ground, mixed saliva with dirt, and anointed the blind man's eyes with it.

reading.ru: «А теперь пойди и умойся в пруду Силаам», — сказал он слепому.
reading.question: Where did Jesus tell the man to wash?
options: In a well near the temple
reading.explain: Jesus told him to go and wash in the pool of Siloam.

reading.ru: Соседи его и те, кто раньше видели его просящим милостыню, спрашивали, «Разве это не он сидел и просил милостыню?»
reading.question: What did the neighbors wonder about the healed man?
options: Whether he was the same man who used to beg
Whether he was a Roman soldier
Whether he was a relative of Lazarus
Whether he was the temple priest
reading.correct: Whether he was the same man who used to beg
reading.explain: The neighbors who had seen him begging asked whether this was the same man.

reading.ru: Человека, который раньше был слепым, привели к фарисеям, потому что Иисус смешал грязь и открыл ему глаза в субботу.
reading.question: Why was the healing brought before the Pharisees as a problem?
options: Because it happened on the Sabbath
Because the man refused to pay a fee
Because Jesus healed him without asking
Because the man was not Jewish
reading.correct: Because it happened on the Sabbath
reading.explain: The healing was controversial because Jesus made the mud and opened the man's eyes on the Sabbath.

reading.ru: Иудеи все еще не верили, что он был слеп и что обрел зрение, поэтому позвали его родителей.
reading.question: Whom did the Jewish leaders call in to confirm the healing?
reading.explain: Because the Jews doubted the healing, they summoned the man's parents.

reading.ru: «Воздай славу Богу», — сказали они. «Мы знаем, что этот человек грешник».
reading.question: What did the leaders demand of the healed man the second time they questioned him?
options: That he give glory to God, since they believed Jesus was a sinner
That he pay back the cost of his sight
reading.correct: That he give glory to God, since they believed Jesus was a sinner
reading.explain: They told him to give glory to God, insisting that Jesus was a sinner.

reading.question: What happened to the healed man after he defended Jesus?
reading.explain: After he argued with them, the religious leaders threw him out.

reading.ru: Иисус сказал, «Я пришел в этот мир для суда, чтобы слепые видели, а те, кто видят, стали слепыми».
reading.question: What did Jesus say was the purpose of his coming, according to this passage?
options: For judgment, so the blind would see and those who see would become blind
To end all sickness in the world
To condemn the Pharisees to death
reading.correct: For judgment, so the blind would see and those who see would become blind
reading.explain: Jesus said he came into the world for judgment, that the blind would see and those who see would become blind.
